scene.bubble: Yesterday we visited the science museum — and Erik talked to the robot for one whole hour!
scene.intro: Yesterday the class visited the science museum! They walked around the big hall, they watched a film about the planets and they listened to a guide with a very loud voice. Valentina played with the light machine three times. Erik talked to the guide for twenty minutes and the bus waited for him. What did YOU do yesterday? Tell the story in the past!

data.text: Yesterday our class visited the science museum. We walked there in twenty minutes. First we watched a film about volcanoes — the screen was as big as a wall! Then we visited the robot room. A small robot called Beep talked with us and answered our questions. Erik asked it eleven questions! At midday we played in the museum garden and listened to a scientist who studies whales. Everyone laughed when she showed us how whales sing. We arrived home tired and happy.
